_note: File-loaded rules honor ONLY action_type/environment/allow/deny/escalate. LoadStoreFromFile parses `conditions` then discards it (patterns, require_explicit_approval, agent_id, resource_pattern are no-ops) and never reads min_trust_score/min_trust_level. The keys below are renamed to _conditions_ignored so they document intent without silently implying enforcement.

rules.description: Read-only git pull is always safe in any environment
Read-only git fetch is always safe in any environment
Git checkout modifies working tree — requires approval to prevent accidental overwrites
Direct subprocess execution requires approval in all environments
Dangerous shell patterns in dev escalate for safety review
Shell in local environment is allowed for development
Catch-all: all actions in production require explicit approval
